statement: For every real delta with 0 < delta < 1/6, for the exact three-job restricted-assignment instance, nonincreasing-size interval order, half-open slot convention, and job-saturating Step-3 matching definition frozen in source.md, the slot graph has exactly eight valid job-to-slot matchings. Their induced makespan multiset, counted with matching multiplicity, is {(11/6-delta)^1, (4/3-delta)^2, 1^5}; hence the minimum makespan is 1 and the maximum is 11/6-delta. No assertion is made about endpoints, other fractional points, or arbitrary instances of the rounding algorithm.
contribution: A complete uniform symbolic resolution of the frozen full-parameter claim. It upgrades the cited primary manuscript's three sampled census values to an exact theorem on the whole open parameter interval, via an invariant half-open adjacency proof, exhaustive matching classification, affine load table, and reproducible exact-rational replay. This is a bounded claim about the stated family, not a new general approximation theorem or an assertion of priority.
